capabilities: Stream live speech-to-text at the cursor via Google Gemini
Filter out noise, breathing and hallucinated greetings before transcription
Ask spoken questions about selected or whole notes and get Markdown answers
Set custom shortcut keys for start, pause and stop
Adjust live update speed and microphone input
extras: Desktop-only (requires Obsidian 1.5.0+). The API key is stored in plain text in the plugin's data.json and the README warns not to sync or share it. Audio goes directly from the machine to Google's Gemini API; the plugin has no intermediary server. Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author built it with right-to-left and multilingual writers in mind, so Persian, Arabic and mixed-language dictation work in their native scripts and shortcuts use physical keys that survive keyboard-layout switches.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in voice dictation, and most dictation tools only dump text after you finish speaking rather than streaming it live as you talk.

relations.evidence: High-accuracy live voice dictation for Obsidian, powered by Google Gemini.

summary: Voice dictation plugin that streams live speech-to-text at the cursor via Google Gemini, plus an Ask AI mode that answers spoken questions about your notes.
